Add a task for my assistant
What this phone lets my assistant do
One-tap buttons: talk to your assistant, add a task, log water, log weight

Lets the Nori app read the text and controls on your screen and, only while you have opened the control window in the Nori app, tap, type and scroll when your assistant asks. Nothing is read or done unless you allowed it in the Nori app, it never acts in Settings, the app store, wallets or password managers, it never reads or types into password, card or code fields, and it asks you first before anything like sending, paying or deleting. You can turn it off here at any time.
